overview_description.description: XBorg is an AI infrastructure and fan engagement technology company building personalized digital experiences for brands, creators, gaming organizations, and esports communities. The company combines AI agents, fan data infrastructure, gamification tools, and blockchain-powered ecosystem features to help organizations create highly personalized interactions across multiple platforms.
